doc_title_en: Notice of Revision to Consolidated Business Forecast and Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY3/26
doc_title_jp: 連結業績予想および期末配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 保有株式の一部売却に伴う特別利益及び業績予想の上方修正に伴い、株主への利益還元を充実させるべく増配

summary_en: Year-end dividend raised ¥1.00/share to ¥11.00 (from ¥10.00 prior estimate) for FY3/26 ended 30 Sept 2026. Net profit forecast raised ¥45M to ¥910M on gains from equity sale. Payout ratio targeted at 25%.
summary_jp: FY3/26期末配当を¥1.00増配し¥11.00に修正（前回¥10.00）。保有株式売却利益で当期純利益予想を¥45M上方修正し¥910M。配当性向目安25%。
tag_en: Dividend Hike – ¥11.00/share (from ¥10.00) – FY3/26 year-end – 25% payout ratio target
